portfolios.name: Wick Hunter
portfolios.description: A robot without AI reads prices every 5 seconds. When a contract moves more than 4.5% in 5, 15 or 30 minutes (a wick), it plays the reversal: it buys after a drop and sells after a rise, at 2x the portfolio, with a 5% stop. It exits 60 minutes after entry, then stays out of that contract for 60 minutes. On the bench, the gain disappears with delay: speed is the whole strategy.
